items.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: it was the beginning of a really close friendship, and Jay and I have been very, very good friends ever since.

ctx.x: How did you go about meeting these wonderful fellas, Buddy Tate and Jay McShann and—

Well Buddy I met for the first time when he was touring in Britain and he came to Glasgow in ‘58 and we met at a party afterwards. Jay, that came about because a club opened in ‘72 I think it was, called Bourbon Street, and in its first couple of years or so, or year and a half, I booked the club, and I discovered to my amazement that Jay McShann had never played Toronto. And so I met Jay simply because I phoned him and asked him if he’d like to come up to Toronto and play. And it was the beginning — the end of…
That’s interesting. I’ll bet it was probably neat the first time you called him and heard his voice on the phone, yeah.
